label: recyclableContent
comment: The fraction of the this product (my mass) that has been designed to be recyclable / re-usable. This will be be the total fraction that can avoid waste / landfill.

domainIncludes.comment: High level circularity information about this product.  Note that this does not substitute for detailed product circularity data sheet (PCDS) criteria which would be represented as a self-issued UNTP Digital Conformity Credential as a set of assessments against individual ISO PCDS criteria.
